units: Num. R. s. 1812 ויש אומרים ת̇' כלייה וכ׳ and some say (the ת̇ in מחלוקת̇) intimates takhlith, that is, it brings destruction &c.
<cite ref="Berakhot 17a:11">Ber. 17ᵃ</cite> <he>ת׳ חכמה תשובה וכ׳</he> the end of wisdom is repentance and good deeds, lest a man study … and treat his father with contempt &c.
